[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## What this is"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Out of the box, dsh is a command-line agent with a functional but plain web UI. Everything around it"},{"id":"p11s2","text":", from choosing a model to installing a plugin, happens in a terminal or in `settings.yaml`. This re"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"pository wraps that core in two layers so that the whole workflow happens on screen."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The first layer is the DSH Launcher, a small program of its own. Double-clicking it opens a window w"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"ith 13 pages that together cover the life cycle of a dsh installation: starting and stopping the cor"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"e, installing plugins and skills, browsing sessions and storage, updating and checking the environme"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"nt, reading token statistics, editing the Control Deck, tuning model parameters, managing credential"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"s, editing memory and context, switching skins, and reading logs."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The second layer is a set of 22 plugins that live inside dsh's own pages. They add a Credentials Cen"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ter, model-list sync, web search, media APIs, a desktop pet and a usage-and-cost page to Settings, a"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"nd message editing, temporary chats, file drops and thinking levels to the conversation itself. Noth"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ing is bolted on top of the interface; each panel appears where a built-in one would. Of the 22, 19 "},{"id":"p13s5","text":"were written for this suite and 3 are forks of other people's MIT projects; 8 further community plug"},{"id":"p13s6","text":"ins are used as they are, and the roster at the end lists each one with its provenance."},{"id":"p14s1","text":""The core" throughout this document means the upstream deepseek-harness checked out under `core/`. I"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"t is used exactly as published, which is what lets the Updates page swap it for any upstream version"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" is used exactly as published, which is what lets the Updates page swap it for any upstream version."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"A few properties shape how the whole thing feels in use. Every feature is a plugin or a separate pro"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"gram, so a core upgrade never costs you a feature. A setting changed on a launcher page or in dsh's "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"Settings is picked up within about 1.5 seconds, with no restart step. API keys go into dsh's credent"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ial store, or into the Windows Credential Manager when the keyring plugin is installed, and nowhere "},{"id":"p15s5","text":"else. Both the launcher and dsh listen on this machine only."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## What the screenshots cannot show"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Some capabilities have no panel of their own, or only a corner of one. They are grouped here by what they are for."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"### Optional core capabilities switched on (upstream packages)"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| Capability | What it gives you |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Persistent terminal (the three `dsh-terminal` packages) | the model can open a persistent PTY, sen"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"d commands interactively, read output and send signals, with background jobs |
| Scheduling (`dsh-sc"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"hedule`) | remind the agent at a time or on a fixed rate |
| LSP code intelligence (the three `dsh-l"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"sp` packages) | a TypeScript language server; the model can go to definition, find references and ho"},{"id":"p20s5","text":"ver types |
| MCP client + reference memory server | the official knowledge-graph memory example (en"},{"id":"p20s6","text":"tities, relations, observations); independent from the suite's memory plugin |
| Claude Code / Codex"},{"id":"p20s7","text":" hook bridges | reuse hooks.json files in Claude Code or Codex format |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 1. What dsh does by itself"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"History is append-only and never truncated. When the conversation nears the limit (80% of the contex"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"t window), dsh compacts the oldest stretch into a summary, and from then on the model sees the summa"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"ry instead of the original. `/compact` triggers the same step by hand."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The limit is each model's `contextWindow`, 262,144 by default. Local models rarely load that much, s"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"o set the real value per model on the launcher's Model parameters page; otherwise compaction happens"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" in the wrong place."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Stock dsh has no cross-session memory. In a new session the model starts from nothing."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 2.
